evidence.quote: The Bachelor's degree course in Mechatronics is designed as a full-time course with a duration of 7 semesters, starting in the summer semester (beginning of March).
The language of instruction is English.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
All students who do not come from the EU pay tuition fees of 1,500 euros for each semester.
Depending on the degree program, applicants must first register at hochschulstart.de (German-speaking study programs) or can apply directly through our RWU Portal (English-speaking study programs).
RWU provides you with an online application tool that you can use to submit your initial application.

evidence.quote: Please submit the following documents with your application: Original signed application form A certified copy of your university entrance certificate in English or German English language certificate (TOEFL iBT or IELTS) - not older than 2 years!
Curriculum vitae (CV) Copy of your passport (for verification of name, date and place of birth)

notes: Tuition: DAAD and RWU pages state EUR 1,500 per semester for non-EU applicants; no yearly figure is given, so period is 'semester'. Intake: the summer 2027 application deadline 31 October 2026 comes from the RWU event page listing Mechatronics (EN) among English-taught bachelor's programmes; the applicant must apply online in the RWU portal AND send documents by post regardless of country of origin. Channel: the pages say applicants apply directly through the RWU Portal (no uni-assist/VPD mentioned); foreign-diploma recognition is handled via Studienkolleg Konstanz or ANABIN, but this is not an application channel. Semester contribution (224/215 EUR) is not a tuition fee.

note.en: If your university entrance qualification is not ANABIN-compliant, an aptitude test (TestAS, SAT, ACT, ITB) and an oral examination are required.
